fields.description: Gates the sync client and the staff redirect only. Does NOT affect the permission fence — HR (Instance) users stay fenced to this instance's companies even while it is disabled.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Cutover switch: allow local edits to rows mirrored from this instance. Leave off during the parallel run — the single-writer write-block enforces read-only while this is unchecked.
fields.label: Unlock Mirrored Writes

fields.description: Base URL staff are sent to, e.g. https://example.frappe.cloud
fields.label: URL

fields.description: Used by the one-way shadow sync to read from this instance. Visible to System Manager only (permlevel 1) — the Employee role can read this doctype for the PWA redirect and must never reach these.
fields.label: Sync Credentials

fields.description: API key of a dedicated, least-privilege read-only user on that instance.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: API secret for the SAME user the key belongs to. Encrypted at rest.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: Employees of these companies are sent to this instance.
fields.label: Companies

fields.description: Every schema gap the sync or the survey reports must carry a ruling here before cutover readiness can say READY. 'Not needed on hub' is met by existing; the other two are met only when the gap stops appearing in the latest evidence.
fields.label: Schema Gap Rulings
